calculate_squad_metrics: calculate SQuAD exact match and F1 score metrics from predicted and target answers
compute_exact_matches: compute exact match count between predicted answers and ground truth answer lists
compute_f1_score: compute token-level F1 score across all predicted and target SQuAD answers
normalize_answer: normalize an answer string by lowercasing, removing punctuation, articles, and extra whitespace
unnumberize_answer: convert token-level start and end indices back to character-level answer spans in raw text
